name: legal_citation_format
description: Format and parse legal citations: Spanish legislation as published in the BOE ("Ley 39/2015, de 1 de octubre, ... «BOE» núm. 236, de 2 de octubre de 2015, pp. 89343-89410") with BOE-A links and ELI URLs; EU acts from EUR-Lex (CELEX number to and from "Regulation (EU) 2016/679", the full title with its Official Journal reference, ELI and EUR-Lex URLs, in English or Spanish); European Case Law Identifiers checked against the ECLI rules; and US case citations in Bluebook form ("Brown v. Board of Education, 347 U.S. 483 (1954)"), built from parts or parsed.

parse.description: A citation or identifier to read; the system is detected

parts.description: Pieces to format; keys depend on the system

type.description: boe: Ley, Ley Orgánica, Real Decreto, Real Decreto-ley, Real Decreto Legislativo, Orden

title.description: the title as it follows the date

author.description: of the European Parliament and of the Council

catalog.source: original; BOE citation and ELI practice (boe.es), EUR-Lex CELEX number structure and the Interinstitutional Style Guide numbering of EU acts, Council conclusions on ECLI (OJ C 127, 29.4.2011, p. 1), The Bluebook rule 10 for case citations
